scope: Curated primary-source research leads for human-reviewed Njia content updates; not imported programme records

sources.title: KUCCPS placement eligibility and selection
sources.publisher: Kenya Universities and Colleges Central Placement Service
sources.claim: KUCCPS lists baseline placement grades: degree C+ and above; diploma C/C-; certificate D+/D; artisan D-/E. Actual programme-specific requirements, priorities and capacities also govern selection.
sources.action: Show these as general entry guidance, not guaranteed eligibility for a named course.

sources.title: 2026 placement opening announcement
sources.claim: The 2026 main placement application window ran 7 April to 6 May 2026; TVET placement is continuous and the 2026 application accepted previous KCSE cohorts subject to stated restrictions.
sources.action: Archive the dates as historical; never show them as a currently open application window.

sources.title: 2026/2027 degree programme cutoff downloads
sources.claim: KUCCPS publishes a 2026/2027 degree-programme cutoff download dated 8 April 2026.
sources.action: Treat programme cutoffs as cycle-specific and separate from minimum admission grades; verify individual rows before importing.

sources.title: Accredited TVET institutions and programme verification
sources.claim: Before selecting a TVET provider, verify registered-and-licensed status, licence expiry and approval to offer the specific programme using the TVETA register.
sources.action: Require institution and programme-level evidence; never infer approval from a college name alone.

sources.title: KUCCPS student portal
sources.claim: The KUCCPS student portal lists available learning institutions and programmes and distinguishes public university scholarships from private-university loan eligibility.
sources.action: Use as the final live check for programme availability, deadlines and placement details.

sources.title: Student-centred higher education funding
sources.claim: Placement and financing are separate processes. Public university scholarships depend on eligibility and assessed need; students must apply for funding.
sources.action: Never treat a KUCCPS placement as an automatic scholarship or promise an award.

sources.title: Higher Education Financing portal
sources.claim: Funding applications require an admission letter; the portal provides current guidance for university and TVET funding.
sources.action: Send applicants to the official portal for current windows and document requirements; do not hardcode the portal countdown.
